results.answer: Allowed labels describe provenance form, not truth. quotation: exact source wording; requires source_id and location. Example: [quotation, source_id=S1, location=p3]. paraphrase: faithful restatement from a source; requires source_id. Example: [paraphrase, source_id=S1] “The deadline is Friday.” observation: directly recorded by an observer on a date; requires observer and date. assumption: analyst-supplied premise on a date; requires analyst and date. synthesis: content assembled from cited note components; requires component_note_ids. Example: [synthesis, component_note_ids=[N1,N2]]. note_id is optional for every label. Mixed-content rule: split a note into atomic segments and label each segment separately. A faithful sourced restatement remains paraphrase even when the analyst agrees with it. Coverage: all five allowed labels are defined, every required metadata field is specified, optional note_id is addressed, mixed content is handled, and the agreement edge case is covered.
